adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly changes `CalendarEvent.destinationCalendar` from `DestinationCalendar | null` to `DestinationCalendar[] | null` in both the implementation class and public types (`packages/core/builders/CalendarEvent/class.ts`, `packages/types/Calendar.d.ts`). It also updates at least one webhook E2E expectation from `destinationCalendar: null` to `destinationCalendar: []` (`apps/web/playwright/webhook.e2e.ts`), and many event constructors now wrap a single calendar in an array or emit `[]` (e.g. `apps/web/pages/api/cron/bookingReminder.ts`, `packages/features/ee/payments/api/webhook.ts`, `packages/trpc/.../confirm.handler.ts`). This is a verifiable payload shape change that can break external consumers expecting an object/null (e.g. `payload.destinationCalendar.integration`). The diff does not show any backwards-compat shim or dual-field emission; the versioning/migration-note aspect cannot be proven from the diff, but the breaking contract change itself is diff-grounded.
